title: Documented defaults for the concentration unit and the maximum concentration differ from the code
reason: The code sets param.concUnit = 10-3 (evaluates to 7), an evident typo for 1e-3 ('assumes concentrations are in mMol'), and maxConc = inf (minConc = 0) while the help gives 1e4 (1e-4) and the option is called 'maximimumFiniteRange'. Documenting 7 and inf would write a slip down as behaviour.
note: The concUnit help line (65-67) already reads 'default `10-3`, i.e. assumes ... mMol' at HEAD, not 1e-3 as the entry says; the entry's LINES 131-137 are stale (the defaults are at lines 149-161). concUnit is not used elsewhere in the file. maxConc/minConc alone might be A if inf/0 are intended; left as C (one entry, in doubt).

title: The help text says the collapsed pathways are combined as absolute values; they are net values

reason: Help said fcont is true if fluxes were supplied; createMetIntrcNetwork sets fcont = 1 for the default all-ones fluxes and hit_node draws flux colours only for fcont = 0. Help reworded to state 1 = no fluxes supplied, 0 = fluxes supplied.
